1.t: When that which is coming arrives,

2.t: no one will be able to deny it has come,

4.t: When the earth is shaken violently

5.t: and the mountains are ground to powder

7.t: then you will be sorted into three classes.

8.t: Those on the Right––what people they are!

9.t: Those on the Left––what people they are!

11.t: For these will be the ones brought nearest to God

14.t: and a few from later generations.

16.t: they will sit facing each other;

17.t: everlasting youths will go round among them

18.t: with glasses, flagons, and cups of a pure drink

19.t: that causes no headache or intoxication;

20.t: [there will be] any fruit they choose;

21.t: the meat of any bird they like;

24.t: a reward for what they used to do.

25.t: They will hear no idle or sinful talk there,

27.t: Those on the Right, what people they are!

28.t: They will dwell amid thornless lote trees

41.t: But those on the Left, what people they are!

42.t: They will dwell amid scorching wind and scalding water

43.t: in the shadow of black smoke,

47.t: always saying, ‘What? When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then be raised up?

50.t: will all be gathered on a predetermined Day

51.t: and you who have gone astray and denied the truth

52.t: will eat from the bitter tree of Zaqqum,

56.t: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgement.

57.t: It was We who created you: will you not believe?

59.t: do you create it yourselves or are We the Creator?

60.t: We ordained death to be among you. Nothing could stop Us

61.t: if We intended to change you and recreate you in a way unknown to you.

62.t: You have learned how you were first created: will you not reflect?

63.t: Consider the seeds you sow in the ground-

64.t: is it you who make them grow or We?

65.t: If We wished, We could turn your harvest into chaff and leave you to wail,

69.t: was it you who brought it down from the rain-cloud or We?

70.t: If We wanted, We could make it bitter: will you not be thankful?

72.t: is it you who make the wood for it grow or We?

73.t: We made it a reminder, and useful to those who kindle it,

74.t: so [Prophet] glorify the name of your Lord, the Supreme.

75.t: I swear by the positions of the stars-

76.t: a mighty oath, if you only knew-

77.t: that this is truly a noble Quran,

79.t: that only the purified can touch,

80.t: sent down from the Lord of all being.

81.t: How can you scorn this statement?

82.t: And how, in return for the livelihood you are given, can you deny it?

83.t: When the soul of a dying man comes up to his throat

85.t: We are nearer to him than you, though you do not see Us-

86.t: why, if you are not to be judged,

87.t: do you not restore his soul to him, if what you say is true?

88.t: If that dying person is one of those who will be brought near to God,

89.t: he will have rest, ease, and a Garden of Bliss;

90.t: if he is one of those on the Right,

91.t: [he will hear], ‘Peace be on you,’ from his companions on the Right;

92.t: but if he is one of those who denied the truth and went astray,

93.t: he will be welcomed with scalding water.

96.t: [Prophet], glorify the name of your Lord the Supreme.
